newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Shell, Occidental units eye Philippine oil, gas.
newsitem.headline: Shell, Occidental units eye Philippine oil, gas.

text.p: The drilling group of Shell Philippines Exploration BV and Occidental Philippines Inc has identified five new oil and gas prospects in the country, the Department of Energy said on Thursday.

In a report to Energy Secretary Francisco Viray, assistant secretary Guillermo Balce said the group was interested in four offshore gas prospects and one oil prospect within the Malampaya/Camago field in southwestern part of the country.
The exploration group is the operator of the Malampaya/Camago field.
The prospects have estimated aggregate reserves of 1.97 to 8.49 trillion cubic feet of gas and 124 million barrels of oil.
"These gas prospects ... are too small to develop on a stand-alone basis and will be developed as subsea satellites to existing Malampaya/Camago production facilities," Balce said.
The oil prospect in the San Marcelino area is expected to be drilled in the second semester of the year.
Shell Philippines is the local exploration arm of the Royal Dutch/Shell group of companies, while Occidental Philippines is a subsidiary of Occidental Petroleum Corp .
